info.title: CarSpecsAPI
info.description:
REST API for car specifications: 70,000+ trims from 1945 to present, organised by make, model, generation and trim, with up to 76 fields per trim, plus a VIN decoder and a full database download.

Authenticate with your API key in the `X-API-Key` header. Get a free key at https://carspecsapi.com/auth/signup (100 requests per day). Keep the key on your server; the API does not support calls from browsers (no CORS).

Successful JSON responses are wrapped in `{ success, data, meta }`. Errors return `{ success: false, error: { code, message } }`. Daily limits reset at midnight UTC; counted requests carry `X-RateLimit-*` headers.

post.description:
Decodes a 17-character VIN into up to 143 attributes, such as make, model, model year, engine, safety equipment and manufacturing plant. Works best for vehicles sold in the US. Only attributes that could be decoded are included.

Available on: Starter plan and above.

Downloads the complete database as a ZIP archive containing a CSV file. Each successful download counts toward the Database plan's 100 downloads per calendar year (reset on January 1).

Available on: Database plan.
